items.content: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.

items.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.content: We’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025.

items.title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
items.content: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement.
items.contentSnippet: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement.

items.title: Investing in the public benefit
items.content: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.
items.contentSnippet: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

items.title: An update on independent evaluators
items.content: To evaluate the safety of our systems, Anthropic is giving employee-like access to a team from METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models, and we're in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.
items.contentSnippet: To evaluate the safety of our systems, Anthropic is giving employee-like access to a team from METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models, and we're in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.

items.title: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore
items.content: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore and signed an MOU with the country’s government to advance safe, responsible AI adoption.
items.contentSnippet: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore and signed an MOU with the country’s government to advance safe, responsible AI adoption.

items.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
items.content: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards. Here, we outline how we’ve continued to strengthen these safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.
items.contentSnippet: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards. Here, we outline how we’ve continued to strengthen these safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.

items.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
items.content: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.
items.contentSnippet: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.

items.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
items.content: Anthropic is committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative to accelerate scientific and technological discovery through AI.

items.content: We’re launching the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to securing the systems everyone depends on.

items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
items.content: Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.
items.contentSnippet: Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.

items.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
items.content: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
items.contentSnippet: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

items.title: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap
items.content: Anthropic is investing $100 million in Claude Frontier Academy to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, with cohorts from Accenture, Bain, CBA, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk already underway.

items.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
items.content: Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.

items.content: A rare Ebola strain is spreading in the DRC, with no confirmed vaccine. Global health organizations are using Claude to respond as fast as possible.

items.title: Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
items.content: The Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP) gives life science professionals access to Claude Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work.

items.title: Introducing Claude Mythos and Fable 5.1
items.content: They’re the world’s most advanced models for coding and knowledge work—and their research capabilities offer an early glimpse of how AI models will contribute to scientific progress.

items.title: Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers
items.content: We’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse. EFS works by storing data in cloud infrastructure controlled by the customer, not Anthropic.
items.contentSnippet: We’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse. EFS works by storing data in cloud infrastructure controlled by the customer, not Anthropic.

items.title: Improving our alignment and security efforts
items.content: On July 30, we reported three incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems. We are conducting an in-depth analysis of both incidents, and planning to work with METR for an independent review. In the meantime, we’re sharing some of the changes we’ve made over the past month.

We are conducting an in-depth analysis of both incidents, and planning to work with METR for an independent review. In the meantime, we’re sharing some of the changes we’ve made over the past month.

items.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
items.content: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
items.contentSnippet: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.

items.title: Expanding our support for scientists
items.content: Starting today, 10,000 scientists around the world can get Claude at no cost to start. Verified principal investigators qualify for a Claude Team subscription plan and then add their research team to Standard seats for free, or Premium seats for $15 per month, for up to a year.

items.content: We’re launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.
